items.title: Google and NASA build AI medical robot for Mars missions
items.excerpt: Google and NASA unveil voice-guided AI medical assistant — Robot will perform tasks 'without ever replacing human decision-making'
items.rationale: Fresh joint Google-NASA unveiling of a voice-guided AI medical robot; novel hardware with a clear human-in-the-loop design stance.

items.title: ChatGPT could soon turn your Android health data into something you can actually use
items.excerpt: ChatGPT on Android is getting ready to read your Google Health data, including historical health data, to offer personalized advice.
items.rationale: APK teardown shows ChatGPT reading Google Health data on Android; wearable data flowing into an assistant is new and has big privacy stakes.

items.title: Google could soon let you put your kids' Gemini chats on a timer
items.excerpt: Google is working on daily Gemini time limits for kids, giving parents more control over how long they use AI.
items.rationale: New parental control for AI use (daily Gemini time limits for kids); a distinct feature, not related to the Notebooks story it was loosely matched to.

items.title: OpenAI is retiring ChatGPT Classic app, will soon combine Chat and Work tabs in new app
items.excerpt: Users who still rely on the ChatGPT Classic app were greeted today with a message informing them that the app will soon be retired.
items.rationale: Concrete product change for ChatGPT mobile users: Classic app sunset and Chat/Work tabs merging into one app.

items.title: The best speech recognition you can run at home is absolutely tiny, and it runs on a ten-year-old laptop
items.excerpt: I dictated an entire article on an old laptop, and it cost me nothing but 2GB of RAM
items.rationale: Hands-on with a tiny local speech-recognition model (Parakeet) that runs on old hardware; readers can try it right away, and it adds outlet diversity.
